fullContent:
Manikya Bhasma 
 Reference: Rasatantra Sara 
 Introduction 
 Manikya Bhasma is made from certain purified elements to cure Impotency, cardiac disorders, Oligospermia. Being digestive in nature, it enhances the digestive fire. It is very useful in loss of libido. Manikya Bhasma acts as an immunity booster and promotes intellect. It helps in increasing the sperm count. This formulation in beneficial in respiratory disorders also. It acts on vata and kapha doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified Manikya 
 Purified Mercury 
 Purified Orpiment 
 Purified sulphide of Arsenic (Realgar) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush purified sulphur, orpiment realgar to a fine powder and combine it with finely powdered Manikya. Triturate these powders with freshly squeezed lime juice for 4 hours. After the seventh coating with herbal extract small pellets are made and they’re kept in an earthen pot and tightly sealed and is heated at a high temperature using 20 kg of charcoal. The heating process is done 8 times. The final product is now collected, finely powdered and stored. 
 Dosage 
 65 to 125 mg twice daily after meals or as prescribed by your doctor with honey, rock candy, butter. 
 Indications 
 
 Tuberculosis 
 Liver disorders 
 Oligospermia 
 Respiratory disorders 
 Fever 
 Stomach disorders 
 Urinary ailments 
 Sexual strength 
 Polyuria 
 Impotency 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage is not advised. 
 Self-medication should be strictly discouraged. 
 No specific side effects are seen if it is taken in the prescribed dosage. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
